summary.en: Clipboard history: ⌃V lists the text you copied lately and puts in the one you choose (⇧↓ picks several); Suggestions commands are out of the @ list; a crash after long use in some interface languages is fixed.
summary.zh: 剪贴板历史：按 ⌃V 列出最近复制的文字，选一条就放进去（⇧↓ 可多选）；「建议」类型命令不再出现在 @ 列表里；修好了部分界面语言下用久了会崩溃的问题。
